summary.short: Hangzhou municipal measures, in force 19 August 2024 to 31 December 2027, that subsidise and reward AI enterprises, research bodies and computing infrastructure projects across the AI industry chain: R&D grants, interest subsidies, compute vouchers, model-filing and open-source rewards, and talent support.
summary.long: A Hangzhou municipal government office notice issues fourteen measures in five parts to support the AI industry chain. Part 1 (compute infrastructure) provides R&D funding of 25% of state or provincial grants actually received, capped at 5 million yuan; interest subsidies of up to 1.5 percentage points on loans for approved computing infrastructure projects (total investment at least 50 million yuan), capped at 10 million yuan per enterprise per year; and a compute voucher pool raised to 250 million yuan per year, covering up to 30% or 20% of compute contract fees depending on the compute used, capped at 8 million yuan per enterprise per year. Part 2 (model ecosystem) offers a one-off reward of up to 500,000 yuan to enterprises obtaining central generative AI model filing, and tiered rewards of 200,000 to 1 million yuan for up to 10 enterprises contributing to open-source models, alongside competitions and talent recognition. Parts 3 to 5 cover public innovation platforms and manufacturing AI demonstrations, industrial clusters, enterprise attraction, rent reductions and industrial parks, and talent recruitment, training and an AI track in an existing talent programme. The measures apply from 19 August 2024 to 31 December 2027, are led by the Municipal Economy and Information Technology Bureau, and are funded jointly by the city and districts. Overlapping city policies are applied at the highest standard without double counting, and stated amounts are maximum standards.

notes: The text cites no other instrument by number or title. It refers only to the CAC generative AI model filing (中央网信办生成式人工智能模型备案) and to other municipal policies on the same subject without identifying them. Entities are the responsible units (责任单位) named per measure; no named firms, facilities or beneficiaries appear. Measure 1(3) sets a 'may be relaxed' cap for generative multimodal model enterprises without stating the amount. The issuing notice is dated 2024年7月18日 and the measures are stated to take effect on 2024年8月19日 (closing provision); the expiry date 2027年12月31日 is also in the text. Stated amounts are maximum standards; the closing provision says they are shared between municipal and district/county budgets.

relations.note: No other instrument is named as enabling act, amended, repealed, implemented or transposed. Only a generic reference to other municipal policies on the same subject (本市各级其他同类政策) appears; it is not identifiable as a target instrument.

definitions.note: No term is explicitly defined. Terms such as 算力券, 用户企业 and 生成式多模态基础大模型 are used in operative provisions without definition.

enforcement.note: The measures set out subsidies, rewards, interest subsidies and voucher caps (e.g., 算力券 at up to 30% of contract cost; 贴息 limits). The text contains no fines, criminal penalties, licence revocation, benefit clawback, suspension, blocking or other sanction provisions for non-compliance. The only limits stated are maximum grant amounts, which are not penalties.
